dict.confirm.title: ¿Activar Full access?
dict.confirm.description: Full access reduce los pasos de confirmación y permite al agente realizar más acciones directamente, incluidas operaciones sensibles, cambios de archivos o comandos externos. Úsalo solo si confías en la tarea actual.
dict.confirm.acknowledge: Entiendo los riesgos y quiero continuar
dict.auto.label: Auto review
dict.auto.description: Run without a sandbox after an experimental same-model review of every native tool call and PTC inner call.
dict.auto.confirm.title: Enable Auto review (experimental)?
dict.auto.confirm.description: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.
dict.auto.confirm.acknowledge: I understand these risks and want to continue

dict.confirm.title: ¿Activar el acceso completo?
